## Changes

- Default Relay transport to TCP with an explicit TCP or UDP choice.
- Improve browser proxy streaming, reconnection, and WebRTC shutdown behavior.
- Remove the browser petal menu so native text selection works normally.
- Reset the last closed browser tab to the start page, including offline sessions.
- Show connection progress when switching browser devices, with timeout feedback.
- Use HTTP by default for IP addresses while preserving explicitly entered schemes.
- Refresh application branding and keep the browser mascot visible while typing,
  with touch-following eyes and repeating idle animation.

## Downloads

CLI archives are provided for macOS, Linux, and Windows on amd64 and arm64.
Android downloads include per-ABI APKs, a universal APK, and a Play AAB, signed
with the persistent release upload key. Build metadata and SHA256 checksums
are included. This remains a beta release.

Android version name: `0.0.1-beta.13`; base version code: `19`.
App Store submissions are managed separately from this GitHub release.
